turns.question: By how many euros did our average order grow from August to September 2026?
turns.answer: Average order value (EUR) was EUR 92.25 in August 2026 and EUR 114.39 in September 2026, each over the whole calendar month of non-cancelled orders. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
